title: San Diego "red orb" hovering over the harbor (Nov 10): skydivers with flares landing on the USS Midway
title_norm: san diego red orb hovering over the harbor nov 10 skydivers with flares landing on the uss midway
snippet: Source: r/sandiego post "any idea what this is ?" red light in the middle of sky went through downtown, then hovered over the harbor just stayed there for a bit then disappeared. Click to expand... A commenter on the water said it was 2 parachutists landing on the USS Midway, each with 2 flares…
